The four GRANTED entries below are ready for the integrator to fold into protected-keeps.json verbatim: key is `map:pallass/<file>:<field_path>`, and each carries {file, field_path, exact_text, ground} with exact_text resolved against the live post-fix branch. Line numbers are deliberately absent (a field path survives a reformat; a line number does not). All four strings were left byte-untouched by the lane and by the fix wave.

granted.exact_text: Forty-one attempts. Under the last one, in smaller writing than the rest: TRY THE OTHER WAY ROUND.
granted.ground: The region's one earned peak on the apprentice chain. A counted fact (forty-one) plus diegetic lettering that is attributed to the physical surface in the same string ("in smaller writing than the rest") — the §8 CAPS proxy and the judgement agree. The reader assembles who wrote it and why, and the string never says. Zero counter flags it: closer 0, anon 0, neg 0, which is exactly the §10 blind spot the plinth ruling was made for.

granted.exact_text: Nothing there. A clerk two stalls down writes something about you and moves on.
granted.ground: An empty-cell flavour line that characterises the whole city in one observed action, with a real present person doing it — the §6 rule-1 ideal (an action the evidence shows, no motive, no feeling) at its cheapest and most exact. It also does the thing the register's peers fail at: an interior_flavor line that is not scenery. Deliberately unresolved (what was written is never disclosed), which is why it must not be "finished" by a later pass.

granted.exact_text: The smith hands you the slip before the rack does. She says nothing about it. She wouldn't.
granted.ground: The payoff of the region's repeatable-work chain, gated at pallass_fetches_run 5 — the player earned it by running the errand five times. "She wouldn't." is a two-word closer, and it is the one place in the region where a closer is doing character work rather than thesis work: it is a claim about a person the player has watched for five cycles, not a claim about Pallass. Flatten it and the chain has no terminal beat at all.

granted.exact_text: A broad Drake behind a counter worn pale in two places, one where the coins land and one where her elbow goes. Both are hers.
granted.ground: Two concrete wear-marks, and the inference is about years of one woman's own labour rather than an absent agent — the exact counter-case to the region's civic-schedule template. "Both are hers." reads as a closer to the counters but is a possession fact the wear-marks establish, and it is what makes the den shop the one warm room on the tier. Sits beside two already-protected den_shop keeps ($.entities[4].observe, $.entities[5].observe/.toast); this is the third leg of the same MODEL cluster and the only one the tooling missed.

refused.detail: The lane asked for a landing site where the ledger chain's irony could be stated once. Ruled: the chain now states its facts and the player assembles the irony — that is §2.3 working as designed. No new button, no reserve spend. No string action; recorded here for the audit trail only.

deferred_to_close.exact_text: Ordinance 44, third column: tier passes are the property of the city and the responsibility of the bearer. Yours is in your pocket, and now you know whose it is.
deferred_to_close.gate: variant `when` { "elevator_pass_stamped": 1 } — only fires for a player who has already earned and is carrying the stamped tier pass
deferred_to_close.ground: The reviewer flagged this as a possible landmark rather than a demotion: the reversal is earned by a gate the player passed, the civic text is quoted rather than paraphrased, and the second sentence turns the ordinance onto the object in the player's own pocket. Landmark ceiling is 12 with 8 spent and 4 in reserve (§5 ruling); spending is a swap, so granting this needs Fable's allocation call, not a lane's.
deferred_to_close.status: DEFERRED to issue close (Fable rules at integration: grant from reserve as a landmark, or leave classified as-is). String left BYTE-AS-IS by the fix wave either way — no rewrite pending the ruling.
